property_summary: For any caller address, calling airDrop always increases that caller's tokenBalance by 20 on the reference C (i.e. airDrop succeeds and sets tokenBalance[caller] == 20 when caller had zero), whereas the mutant that checks for a different token string will reject callers implemented by Bank and thus may leave their tokenBalance unchanged (failing the rule).
change_summary: Modify supportsToken to compare against a different string, causing the supportsToken check to fail for the Bank implementation and preventing airDrop, thereby changing observed balances.
